notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
description:
Activate Forgotten Cave's cycling ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Forgotten Cave ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a land card, adding {B}.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Forgotten Cave and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
